parameters.name: Body

post.description:
Get a list of projects that the user has access to with project details

List of keys in project data:

_id: Specific id for the project used in case for fetching details of a single project.

project_name : Name of the project unique throughout project.

tag_manager: analytics tag manager keys for google and pixel.

blog_options: Global settings for blog page.
project_url: .cmsoncloud default serving domain.

cdn : distribution domain to add to CNAME in case of custom domain setup.

custom_domain: custom domain properties like CNAME's to add.

hosting: robots and redirection raw file.

image_opt: image optimization settings.

rich_text_editor: WYSIWIG settings.

sitemap: sitemap raw file.

advanced_seo : HSTS header toggle and content security header string.

author: author gives the details for the user who created the project.

live: Boolean.

publish_progress: publish progress in case the whole project is published.

upload_progress: upload progress in case a zip is uploaded or a new project is created.

publish_errlog: publish log either success or failed or errored.

last_cache_refresh: last cache refresh date.

page_speed_api_key: page speed key for generating SEO reports.

template: if the project is exported as a global template.  Properties of the template.

template_used: template id for the template used to create the project.

plan: plan details like charge benefits usage etc.

suspended: Suspension boolean indicator.
